title: Determination of Solubility Product Constant (Ksp) of Calcium Hydroxide
description: Equilibrium titration of saturated aqueous Ca(OH)2 solution with standardized HCl to determine Ksp and Gibbs free energy delta G.
apparatus: Gravity Funnel with Whatman No. 1 Filter Paper
steps: Filter saturated Ca(OH)2 solution through fine filter paper discarding initial 5 mL.
Pipette 20.0 mL of clear filtrate into an Erlenmeyer flask.
Add 2 drops of methyl orange indicator.
Titrate with standardized 0.050 M HCl until color changes from yellow to orange-red.
Calculate [OH-] from volume of HCl titrant consumed.
safety: Calcium hydroxide is strongly basic and caustic to ocular tissues. Immediate flush required on accidental contact.
